{{Quote|All ships and fighters&mdash;prepare to disengage and follow! Release anti-ion emission tracers! Jump on my mark!|Jhoram Bey|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref>}}
'''Anti-ion emission tracers''' were measures used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to prevent other ships from tracing their [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps. The [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']] used them during a [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|battle]] in [[137 ABY]].
